options.content:
# Carbon Emissions Report

This dashboard tracks carbon emissions across various sources of business activity. The data sources surface carbon emissions from Cloud Service Providers (GCP, AWS, Azure) and business travel (Navan). [Learn more](https://github.com/grafana/sustainability-o11y).

targets.rawSql:
SELECT
  SUM(`carbon_footprint_total_kgCO2e`.`location_based`) / 1000 as total
FROM `${gcp_dataset}.carbon_footprint`
WHERE $__timeFilter(TIMESTAMP(usage_month))

SELECT 'Navan' as source, SUM(`total_carbon_emission_tonnes`) as scope3
FROM `grafanalabs-reporting.reports_finance.rpt_finance__navan_carbon_emissions`
WHERE $__timeFilter(TIMESTAMP(created_month))
GROUP BY source;

targets.rawSQL:
SELECT
  SUM(total_lbm_emissions_value) AS total
FROM "AwsDataCatalog"."${athena_database}"."${athena_table}"
WHERE usage_period_start BETWEEN $__timeFrom() AND $__timeTo()
  AND model_version = 'v3.0.0'

targets.rawSql:
SELECT
    SUM(emissions_kg_co2e) / 1000 AS total
FROM `${azure_dataset}.azure_carbon_data_prod`
WHERE $__timeFilter(TIMESTAMP(usage_month));

SELECT
  SUM(`total_carbon_emission_tonnes`) as metric_tons_CO2eq,
  created_month
FROM
  `grafanalabs-reporting.reports_finance.rpt_finance__navan_carbon_emissions`
  WHERE $__timeFilter(TIMESTAMP(created_month))
  GROUP BY
    created_month
  ORDER BY created_month ASC
  LIMIT 1000;

SELECT
  SUM(`carbon_footprint_total_kgCO2e`.`location_based`) / 1000 as metric_tons_CO2eq,
  usage_month,
FROM
  `${gcp_dataset}.carbon_footprint`
  WHERE $__timeFilter(TIMESTAMP(usage_month))
  GROUP BY
    usage_month
  ORDER BY usage_month ASC
  LIMIT 1000;

targets.rawSQL:
SELECT
  usage_period_start AS time,
  ROUND(SUM(total_lbm_emissions_value), 4) AS metric_tons_CO2eq
FROM "AwsDataCatalog"."${athena_database}"."${athena_table}"
WHERE usage_period_start BETWEEN $__timeFrom() AND $__timeTo()
  AND total_mbm_emissions_value > 0
GROUP BY usage_period_start
ORDER BY usage_period_start;

targets.rawSql:
SELECT
    usage_month,
    SUM(emissions_kg_co2e) / 1000 AS metric_tons_CO2eq
FROM `${azure_dataset}.azure_carbon_data_prod`
WHERE $__timeFilter(TIMESTAMP(usage_month))
GROUP BY usage_month
ORDER BY usage_month ASC
LIMIT 1000;

panels.title: Total Carbon Emissions by Source

options.content: This dashboard displays carbon emissions in [metric tons of carbon dioxide equivalent (MtCO₂e)](https://www.ipcc.ch/sr15/chapter/glossary), an industry-standard measurement for all greenhouse gases.

#### Carbon Emissions Breakdown

Carbon emissions are tracked according to the [Greenhouse Gas Protocol](https://ghgprotocol.org/corporate-standard), the most widely used and recognised greenhouse gas accounting standard, which categorizes emissions into three scopes:
- **Scope 1:** All direct emissions from owned or controlled sources.
- **Scope 2:** Indirect emissions from purchased energy generation. For example, these can either use the [Location-Based Method or Market-Based Method](https://github.com/grafana/sustainability-o11y#location-based-method-lbm-vs-market-based-method-mbm).
- **Scope 3:** All other indirect emissions in the value chain (upstream and downstream), including emissions from workloads running on CSPs and business travel.

targets.rawSql:
SELECT
    'GCP' as source,
    SUM(`carbon_footprint_kgCO2e`.`scope3`) / 1000 as scope3
FROM `${gcp_dataset}.carbon_footprint`
WHERE $__timeFilter(TIMESTAMP(usage_month))
GROUP BY source;

SELECT 'Navan' as source, SUM(`total_carbon_emission_tonnes`) as scope3
FROM `grafanalabs-reporting.reports_finance.rpt_finance__navan_carbon_emissions`
WHERE $__timeFilter(TIMESTAMP(created_month))
GROUP BY source;

targets.rawSQL:
SELECT
  'AWS' as source,
  SUM(total_scope_3_lbm_emissions_value) AS scope3
FROM "AwsDataCatalog"."${athena_database}"."${athena_table}"
WHERE usage_period_start BETWEEN $__timeFrom() AND $__timeTo()
  AND model_version = 'v3.0.0'

targets.rawSql:
SELECT
    'Azure' AS source,
    SUM(CASE WHEN scope = 'Scope 3' THEN emissions_kg_co2e ELSE 0 END) / 1000 AS scope3
FROM `${azure_dataset}.azure_carbon_data_prod`
WHERE $__timeFilter(TIMESTAMP(usage_month))
GROUP BY source;

SELECT
    'GCP' as source,
    SUM(`carbon_footprint_kgCO2e`.`scope2`.`location_based`) / 1000 as scope2
FROM `${gcp_dataset}.carbon_footprint`
WHERE $__timeFilter(TIMESTAMP(usage_month))
GROUP BY source;

targets.rawSQL:
SELECT
  'AWS' as source,
  SUM(total_scope_2_lbm_emissions_value) AS scope2
FROM "AwsDataCatalog"."${athena_database}"."${athena_table}"
WHERE usage_period_start BETWEEN $__timeFrom() AND $__timeTo()
  AND model_version = 'v3.0.0'

targets.rawSql:
SELECT
    'Azure' AS source,
    SUM(CASE WHEN scope = 'Scope 2' THEN emissions_kg_co2e ELSE 0 END) / 1000 AS scope2
FROM `${azure_dataset}.azure_carbon_data_prod`
WHERE $__timeFilter(TIMESTAMP(usage_month))
GROUP BY source;

SELECT
    'GCP' as source,
    SUM(`carbon_footprint_kgCO2e`.`scope1`) / 1000 as scope1
FROM `${gcp_dataset}.carbon_footprint`
WHERE $__timeFilter(TIMESTAMP(usage_month))
GROUP BY source;

targets.rawSQL:
SELECT
  'AWS' as source,
  SUM(total_scope_1_emissions_value) AS scope1
FROM "AwsDataCatalog"."${athena_database}"."${athena_table}"
WHERE usage_period_start BETWEEN $__timeFrom() AND $__timeTo()
  AND model_version = 'v3.0.0'

targets.rawSql:
SELECT
    'Azure' AS source,
    SUM(CASE WHEN scope = 'Scope 1' THEN emissions_kg_co2e ELSE 0 END) / 1000 AS scope1
FROM `${azure_dataset}.azure_carbon_data_prod`
WHERE $__timeFilter(TIMESTAMP(usage_month))
GROUP BY source;

SELECT
  usage_month,
  SUM(`carbon_footprint_kgCO2e`.`scope1`) / 1000 AS `Scope 1`,
  SUM(`carbon_footprint_kgCO2e`.`scope2`.`location_based`) / 1000 AS `Scope 2`,
  SUM(`carbon_footprint_kgCO2e`.`scope3`) / 1000 AS `Scope 3`
FROM `${gcp_dataset}.carbon_footprint`
WHERE $__timeFilter(TIMESTAMP(usage_month))
GROUP BY usage_month
ORDER BY usage_month ASC;

panels.title: Google Cloud | Total Emissions by Scope

targets.rawSql:
SELECT
  usage_month,
  SUM(`carbon_footprint_kgCO2e`.`scope1`) / 1000 AS `Scope 1`,
  SUM(`carbon_footprint_kgCO2e`.`scope2`.`location_based`) / 1000 AS `Scope 2`,
  SUM(`carbon_footprint_kgCO2e`.`scope3`) / 1000 AS `Scope 3`
FROM `${gcp_dataset}.carbon_footprint`
WHERE $__timeFilter(TIMESTAMP(usage_month))
GROUP BY usage_month
ORDER BY usage_month ASC;

panels.title: Google Cloud | Emissions by Scope Over Time

targets.rawSql:
SELECT
  SUM(`carbon_footprint_total_kgCO2e`.`location_based`) / 1000 as total_carbon_footprint,
  --`location`.`location`,
  --`location`.`region`,
  --`project`.`id`,
  --`project`.`number`,
  `service`.`description`,
  --`service`.`id`
FROM
  `${gcp_dataset}.carbon_footprint`
  WHERE $__timeFilter(TIMESTAMP(usage_month))
  GROUP BY
    -- usage_month,
    --location.region,
    service.description
  ORDER BY total_carbon_footprint DESC
  LIMIT 10;

panels.title: Google Cloud | Emissions by GCP Service

targets.rawSql:
SELECT
  SUM(`carbon_footprint_total_kgCO2e`.`location_based`) / 1000 as total_carbon_footprint,
  -- usage_month,
  --`location`.`location`,
  `location`.`region`,
  --`project`.`id`,
  --`project`.`number`,
  --`service`.`description`,
  --`service`.`id`
FROM
  `${gcp_dataset}.carbon_footprint`
  WHERE $__timeFilter(TIMESTAMP(usage_month))
  GROUP BY
    -- usage_month,
    location.region
    --service.description
  ORDER BY total_carbon_footprint DESC
  LIMIT 15;

panels.title: Google Cloud | Emissions by GCP Region

panels.description: This pie chart shows the proportion of location-based (LBM) carbon emissions contributed by Scope 1, Scope 2 LBM, and Scope 3 LBM for the selected time range.

targets.rawSQL:
SELECT
  SUM(total_scope_1_emissions_value) AS "Scope 1",
  SUM(total_scope_2_lbm_emissions_value) AS "Scope 2",
  SUM(total_scope_3_lbm_emissions_value) AS "Scope 3"
FROM carbon.v3_0_0_data
WHERE model_version = 'v3.0.0'
  AND $__timeFilter(usage_period_start);

panels.title: AWS | Total Emissions by Scope (Location-Based)

targets.rawSQL:
SELECT
  DATE_TRUNC('month', usage_period_start) AS time,
  location AS metric,
  SUM(total_scope_1_emissions_value + total_scope_2_lbm_emissions_value + total_scope_3_lbm_emissions_value) AS value
FROM carbon.v3_0_0_data
WHERE model_version = 'v3.0.0'
  AND $__timeFilter(usage_period_start)
GROUP BY
  DATE_TRUNC('month', usage_period_start),
  location
ORDER BY time, location

panels.description: Displays monthly CO₂e emissions from AWS, broken down by Scope 1, Scope 2 LBM, and Scope 3 LBM.

targets.rawSQL:
SELECT
  DATE_TRUNC('month', usage_period_start) AS time,
  SUM(total_scope_1_emissions_value) AS "Scope 1",
  SUM(total_scope_2_lbm_emissions_value) AS "Scope 2",
  SUM(total_scope_3_lbm_emissions_value) AS "Scope 3"
FROM carbon.v3_0_0_data
WHERE model_version = 'v3.0.0'
  AND $__timeFilter(usage_period_start)
GROUP BY DATE_TRUNC('month', usage_period_start)
ORDER BY time;

panels.title: AWS | Monthly Carbon Emissions by Scope

targets.rawSQL:
SELECT
  location AS region,
  SUM(total_scope_1_emissions_value) AS scope1,
  SUM(total_scope_2_lbm_emissions_value) AS scope2,
  SUM(total_scope_3_lbm_emissions_value) AS scope3
FROM carbon.v3_0_0_data
WHERE model_version = 'v3.0.0'
  AND $__timeFilter(usage_period_start)
GROUP BY location
ORDER BY (scope1 + scope2 + scope3) DESC

panels.title: AWS | Carbon Emissions per AWS region (LBM Methods)

panels.description: This visualization shows monthly carbon emissions, comparing market-based (MB) and location-based (LB) totals over time.

targets.rawSQL:
SELECT
  DATE_TRUNC('month', usage_period_start) AS time,
  SUM(total_mbm_emissions_value) AS "Market-Based",
  SUM(total_lbm_emissions_value) AS "Location-Based"
FROM carbon.v3_0_0_data
WHERE model_version = 'v3.0.0'
  AND $__timeFilter(usage_period_start)
GROUP BY DATE_TRUNC('month', usage_period_start)
ORDER BY time;

panels.title: AWS | Carbon Emissions Over Time (Market- vs Location-Based)

targets.rawSQL:
SELECT
    region_code AS region,
    SUM(total_lbm_emissions_value) AS total_carbon_footprint
FROM carbon.v3_0_0_data
WHERE usage_period_start >= CAST($__timeFrom() AS timestamp)
  AND usage_period_start <= CAST($__timeTo() AS timestamp)
  AND total_lbm_emissions_value > 0
GROUP BY region_code

targets.rawSql:
SELECT
    SUM(CASE WHEN scope = 'Scope 1' THEN emissions_kg_co2e ELSE 0 END) / 1000 AS `Scope 1`,
    SUM(CASE WHEN scope = 'Scope 2' THEN emissions_kg_co2e ELSE 0 END) / 1000 AS `Scope 2`,
    SUM(CASE WHEN scope = 'Scope 3' THEN emissions_kg_co2e ELSE 0 END) / 1000 AS `Scope 3`
FROM `${azure_dataset}.azure_carbon_data_prod`
WHERE $__timeFilter(TIMESTAMP(usage_month));

panels.description: Displays monthly CO₂ emissions from Azure, broken down by Scope 1, Scope 2, and Scope 3.

targets.rawSql:
SELECT
    usage_month AS time,
    SUM(CASE WHEN scope = 'Scope 1' THEN emissions_kg_co2e ELSE 0 END) / 1000 AS `Scope 1`,
    SUM(CASE WHEN scope = 'Scope 2' THEN emissions_kg_co2e ELSE 0 END) / 1000 AS `Scope 2`,
    SUM(CASE WHEN scope = 'Scope 3' THEN emissions_kg_co2e ELSE 0 END) / 1000 AS `Scope 3`
FROM `${azure_dataset}.azure_carbon_data_prod`
WHERE $__timeFilter(TIMESTAMP(usage_month))
GROUP BY usage_month
ORDER BY usage_month;

panels.title: Azure | Monthly CO₂ Emissions by Scope

targets.rawSql:
SELECT
  location AS region,
  SUM(CASE WHEN scope = 'Scope 1' THEN emissions_kg_co2e ELSE 0 END) / 1000 AS scope1,
  SUM(CASE WHEN scope = 'Scope 2' THEN emissions_kg_co2e ELSE 0 END) / 1000 AS scope2,
  SUM(CASE WHEN scope = 'Scope 3' THEN emissions_kg_co2e ELSE 0 END) / 1000 AS scope3
FROM `${azure_dataset}.azure_carbon_data_prod`
WHERE $__timeFilter(TIMESTAMP(usage_month))
  AND location IS NOT NULL
GROUP BY location
ORDER BY (scope1 + scope2 + scope3) DESC

panels.title: Azure | Carbon Emissions by Azure region

targets.rawSql:
SELECT
  SUM(emissions_kg_co2e) / 1000 AS total_carbon_footprint,
  resource_type
FROM `${azure_dataset}.azure_carbon_data_prod`
WHERE $__timeFilter(TIMESTAMP(usage_month))
  AND resource_type IS NOT NULL
GROUP BY resource_type
ORDER BY total_carbon_footprint DESC
LIMIT 10
